attempts.summary: Formed a 3-node RabbitMQ cluster (node1, node2, node3) with a durable payments vhost, an application user (app_user) with full permissions, and an ha-all mirroring policy so queues survive node loss. Verified this by stopping node1 mid-flight and successfully consuming all 3 previously-published durable messages from node2 after failover. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming boot_id changes and full cluster/vhost/policy recovery after each restart, plus a final end-to-end publish/consume check on node1.
